children: Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced crypto and cash holdings of $15.6 billion and 5.90 million ETH holdings (4.9% of supply).
Holds 5,901,112 ETH valued at $2,511 each, totaling $12.7B staked ETH and 5.90M ETH overall (4.9% of 120.7M supply).
Total crypto + cash, marketable securities and "moonshots" equal $15.6B, including $541M cash & marketable securities.
Staked ETH of 5,067,309 generates an annualized staking revenue projection of $340M (7‑day yield 2.67% annualized).
Company has acquired ETH weekly for 65 weeks, adding 53,501 ETH over the past week toward a 5% supply goal.
Added to Russell 1000 large‑cap; Series A Preferred trades on NYSE under symbol BMNP; MAVAN launched as institutional staking platform.
